title: Turn latent transport into whole finite-observation TV
statement: Given ANY coupling of simplex-valued X,Y, sample r ordered categorical observations conditionally independently given each latent vector. Couple each coordinate maximally conditional onX,Y and independently across positions. Both rows retain their ENTIRE required mixture-of-product laws and P(rows differ)<=E min(1,(r/2)||X-Y||1), so whole observation-TV<=(r/2)E||X-Y||1. Multinomial count projection has no larger TV. Composition with the shared-gamma/count-index bound is valid when the index coupling is actually supplied. This is a finite observation kernel with known mathematical parameters, not latent continuous-TV control, arbitrary adaptive observations, a finite-bit sampler or unknown-law probability access for the sample-only exact reuse problem.
